capabilities.justification: Uses the Haskell Conduit wrapper to call the reviewed Rust Conduit C ABI.
Loads the conduit_capi dynamic library required by the Haskell Conduit wrapper.
The demo binds a caller-selected TCP port on all interfaces for HTTP requests.
Smoke tests bind an ephemeral TCP listener on the loopback interface.
Smoke tests connect to the loopback listener with raw HTTP sockets.
Smoke tests resolve the numeric loopback host before connecting to the listener.
Reads PORT to select the TCP listening port, defaulting to 8080.
Reads APP_ENV to populate the demonstrated application environment setting.
Smoke tests use bounded thread delays while starting and stopping the server.
Writes the selected listening port to the standard error output stream when the demo starts.

justification: Demo server calls conduit_capi, listens for HTTP traffic, reads PORT and APP_ENV, logs startup to standard error, and runs loopback smoke tests.
